What We Do

Complete landscape care, start to finish

From the first sketch to season-round upkeep, Max Care handles every stage so your property looks its best year after year.

Design

Turning your vision into a plan
  • Paver DesignCustom walkways, patios, and driveways designed to fit your space and style
  • Retaining Wall DesignFunctional, erosion-controlling walls that also add structure and visual interest
  • Fire Pit DesignGathering spaces designed for year-round outdoor living
  • Planting DesignThoughtful plant selection and layout based on your climate, sunlight, and maintenance preferences

Install

Bringing the plan to life
  • Plant InstallationProfessional planting of trees, shrubs, and flowers for healthy, long-term growth
  • Mulch InstallationFresh mulch to protect soil, suppress weeds, and finish your beds
  • Rock & Stone InstallationDecorative rock, gravel, and stone for drainage, pathways, or low-maintenance beds
  • Irrigation & DrainageEfficient watering systems and drainage solutions to protect your investment

Maintenance

Keeping it looking its best
  • Seasonal Trimming & CleanupRegular upkeep to keep your landscape neat through every season
  • Tree Pruning & TreatmentExpert pruning and health treatments to keep trees strong and attractive
About Us

A knack for this, since before he could drive

Max was mowing lawns and shaping beds before most kids his age were old enough to have a paper route. What started as an early feel for the work — the kind you can't really teach — turned into a full career built one yard at a time.

That hands-on experience is still the foundation of every project Max Care takes on today. But the part he actually enjoys most is earlier than that: sitting down with a client, hearing what they picture when they look out their back door, and figuring out how to get them there.

A consultation isn't a formality here — it's where the project actually starts. Getting on the same page before anything gets drawn or dug is what makes the rest of the process go smoothly, and it's what turns a client's vision into something real.
